english.title: False statement in an application for a provisional statement in relation to premises - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly or recklessly made a false statement, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE STATEMENT..), in or in connection with an application for a provisional statement under Part 3 of the Licensing Act 2003
english.legislation: Contrary to section 158(1)(b) and (3) of the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly/recklessly made a false statement
in/in connection with an application for a provisional statement
under Part 3 of the Licensing Act 2003

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 158(2) provides that a person is to be treated as making a false statement if he produces, furnishes, signs or otherwise makes use of a document that contains a false statement.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
